name: Izy Focus Reporter
description: Exposes the focused window's title and app id on the session bus at org.izy.Focus, so Izy can tell what you are working on. GNOME/Wayland offers no other route: EWMH returns 0x0, Shell.Eval is locked, and Shell.Introspect is allowlist-gated. Reads only; changes nothing about your session.
